items.docs:
The Corporate Actions – Price, Mergers and Acquisitions package provides data on dividends and other payments to shareholders, stock splits, rights issues, and spin offs, as well as mergers and acquisitions made by the issuing companies, and the adjustment factors relating to these corporate actions.

The package contains the following datasets:

  - Capital Repayment

  - Cash Dividend

  - Mergers and Acquisitions

  - Rights Issue

  - Spin Off

  - Stock Split

Time series data supported.
